title: Inside Line Equipment Camera Sling
content:
Inside Line Equipment makes some of the smartest camera bags, including its Camera Sling ($150). This compact bag fits your mirrorless body and a prime lens, plus a few accessories. It’s small and compact, with padding to protect your camera for on- and off-the-bike outings.

Specs:

  • Durable Cordura, XPAC Sailcloth, or Waxed Canvas
  • Padded camera compartment
  • Small zippered pocket for SD cards or accessories
  • Expandable front pocket with interior elastic loops for SD cards, batteries, lens cloth, etc.
  • Removable stabilizer strap set up for left shoulder, but can be user-converted to right shoulder use
  • Water-resistant urethane-coated YKK zipper
  • Fits mirrorless camera or small DSLR with pancake lens (pictured with Leica Q3 43)
  • Dimensions: 5.5″ (14 cm) x 4″ (10.2 cm) x 6″ (15.2 cm)
  • Handmade in California

Check out more at ILE.
